theme_and_archetype.description: A refined, confident, grown-up B2B agency. Clean structure, clarity, and restraint.

layout_and_spacing.alignment: Strictly left-aligned hierarchy. Avoid centering content.
layout_and_spacing.borders: 1px hairline dividers using #E5E0D8. NO shadows, NO boxy cards.

motion.hero_animation: Word 'root' connects to 'link' via a thin drawn line on page load (1.2s). SVG stroke drawing.
motion.forbidden: NO parallax, NO zoom, NO autoplay video, NO animated gradients.

pages_and_sections.navigation: Sticky minimal nav. Wordmark (Rootlink) + AI subtext. Links: Services, About, Contact, CTA ('Book a session').
homepage: Hero: Type-driven, featuring the root->link animation. No hero illustration.
Who This Is For: 4-up grid with moss green (#1F3D2F) dots as bullets.
Services: 3 numbered rows (01/02/03) separated by hairline dividers.
How We Work: 3 horizontal steps, purely text/typographic.
Newsletter Signup: Terracotta-tinted, inline minimalist form.
Inquiry Form CTA: Final massive text block leading to form.
pages_and_sections.about_page: Editorial single column, long-form text, prominent pull quotes.
pages_and_sections.services_page: Expanded sections per service. Clean grid, hairline borders.

component_rules.buttons: Flat, primary background #1F3D2F, text #FAF7F2. Hover state background #C76E3F.
component_rules.inputs: Minimalist. border-b only or very thin full borders using #E5E0D8. Focus state border #1F3D2F. No heavy outlines.
component_rules.cards: Do not use traditional shadowed cards. Use structural divs separated by borders.
component_rules.footer: 3-column layout. Wordmark+tagline, nav links, LinkedIn social icon.

about_textures_and_lifestyle.description: black and brown leather padded tub sofa - use sparingly as a background or contextual image on the About page.
white desk lamp beside green plant - use in services or contact page if a clean image is needed.

instructions_to_main_agent: STRICTLY adhere to the exact hex codes provided. Do NOT use Tailwind default colors.
NO stock photos of robots, headsets, or futuristic AI concepts. Stick to the editorial, high-end agency aesthetic.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for the layout structure, using 1px hairline borders extensively for structure instead of boxes.
Ensure all interactive elements have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="nav-book-session-button"`).
Generate and update files using .js extension (not .tsx), as the project is in JavaScript.
